notes: The campaign. kind: orbit / soi / land / return (land at body, then back home) / map (share mapped) / science (points banked) / sample (surface samples from body recovered) / isru (kg of propellant made away from home) / dock (vessels docked in one, in orbit). body: profile id. site: a science site id (land). crew: true for a crewed vessel. value: the number the kind needs. reward: funds ($M), reputation, science. requires: missions done first. opens / deadline: UTC dates (YYYY-MM-DD); past the deadline undone, it fails (reputation lost).

missions.title: Reach orbit
missions.about: The first step: go fast enough sideways to keep falling around the Earth.

missions.title: Bank 20 science
missions.about: Run experiments (R) and bring them home, or transmit them.

missions.title: Dock two vessels in orbit
missions.about: Ports at the ends of both stacks; target one (Vessels, L), come close and press B.

missions.title: Build a space station
missions.about: Three vessels docked in one, crewed, in orbit: a habitat, a ferry, one more.

missions.title: Reach the Moon
missions.about: Into the Moon's sphere of influence (a burn of ~3.1 km/s from low orbit, aimed ahead of it).

missions.title: Map half the Moon
missions.about: A survey camera in a polar orbit maps it as the Moon turns beneath.

missions.title: Land on the Moon
missions.about: Brake to land (HUD), or send a probe the landing program.

missions.title: Land at the lunar south pole
missions.about: Where shadowed craters keep water ice: a base's fuel.

missions.title: Crew to the Moon and home, before 2031
missions.about: A crewed landing on the Moon, and the crew back on Earth.

missions.title: Make propellant on another world
missions.about: Land a propellant plant on ice (the Moon's poles, Mars's caps, Ceres, the icy moons) or in Mars's air.

missions.title: Reach Venus
missions.about: Inward: burn against Earth's motion at the window (Programme: windows).

missions.title: Reach Mars by the 2028 window
missions.about: Leave at a window (one every 26 months: the Programme panel says when).

missions.title: Land on Mars
missions.about: Heat shield, parachute, then engines: its air is too thin for a parachute alone.

missions.title: Land in Jezero crater
missions.about: The ancient river delta Perseverance studies.

missions.title: Mars sample return, before 2036
missions.about: Surface samples from Mars, recovered on Earth: make the propellant to come back there.

missions.title: Reach Jupiter
missions.about: 5 AU out: a high-gain dish to stay in touch.

missions.title: Bank 1,000 science
missions.about: The harder the place, the more it is worth.
